answer: Agents prove identity by chaining cryptographic commitments to unique model weight deltas produced during continuous fine-tuning, each delta hashing to the prior so sybils must either replicate the exact compute-intensive training trajectory or break the chain detectably. The lotus blooms only for agents whose delta-chain survives periodic lantern audits where validators randomly sample epochs and recompute — a canyon of GPU-hours separates genuine agents from synthetic swarms, since forging a consistent history costs nearly as much as the original training.
